!"CLEAR & START NEW"
/CLEAR,NOSTART

YM = 200e9   !"Young's Modulus of Steel"
YS = 250e6   !"Yield Strength of Steel"
PR = 0.3     !"Poisson Ratio of Steel"
A = 0.01     !"Link Cross-Section Area"

!"SELECT TEST CASE"
Case = 3

!"SELECT ELEMENT TYPE"
/PREP7
ET,Truss,LINK180
KEYOPT,1,2,1
KEYOPT,1,12,0

!"SELECT MATERIAL MODEL"
MPTEMP, , , , , , , , 
MPTEMP,1,0
MPDATA,EX,1, ,YM
MPDATA,PRXY,1, ,PR

!"DEFINE ELEMENT CROSS-SECTION AREA"
SECTYPE,1,LINK, ,Truss
SECDATA,A, 
SECCONTROL,0,0


!"----------------------------------------------------------------"
!"CREATE GEOMETRY OF STRUCTURE"
!"----------------------------------------------------------------"


!"CREATE KEYPOINTS"

LSTR,2,3

LSTR,4,5

LSTR,6,7
LSTR,7,8

LSTR,12,13
LSTR,13,14

!"GET TOTAL NUMBER OF LINES"
*GET,n_Line,LINE, ,COUNT, , , 

!"MESH ALL LINES"

FLST,2,n_Line,4,ORDE,2
FITEM,2,1
FITEM,2,-n_Line
LMESH,P51X

!"GET TOTAL NUMBER OF NODES"
*GET,n_Node,NODE, ,COUNT, , , 

!"GET TOTAL NUMBER OF ELEMENTS"
*GET,n_Elem,ELEM, ,COUNT, , , 

!"STORE ELEMENT CROSS-SECTION AREA"
*DIM,e_Area,ARRAY,n_Elem,1,1, , , 
*DO,i,1,n_Elem,1
		e_Area(i) = A
*ENDDO

!"STORE ELEMENT LENGTH"
*DIM,e_Length,ARRAY,n_Elem,1,1, , , 
*DO,i,1,n_Elem,1
		*GET,len,ELEM,i,LENG
		e_Length(i) = len
*ENDDO

!"CALCULATE INITIAL TOTAL VOLUME"
V0 = 0
*DO,i,1,n_Elem,1
		V0 = V0 + e_Length(i)*e_Area(i)
*ENDDO

!"STATIC ANALYSIS OF ORIGINAL STRUCTURE"
!"----------------------------------------------------------------"


!"APPLY BOUNDARY CONDITIONS"

FITEM,2,1

/GO
D,P51X,ALL,0, , , , , , , , , 

!"APPLY TEST CASE"
*IF,Case,EQ,1,THEN
		!"APPLY LOAD AT THE BTM NODE"
		FLST,2,1,1,ORDE,1
		FITEM,2,7
		/GO
		F,P51X,FY,FL

*DO,i,1,n_Node,1
		node_Disp_Y(i) = ABS(node_Disp_Y(i))
*ENDDO

!"EXTRACT ELEMENT VON MISES STRESS"

*DIM,SEQV_raw,ARRAY,n_Elem,1,1, , , 
*VGET,SEQV_raw,ELEM, ,ETAB,e_SEQV

*DO,i,1,n_Elem,1
		SEQV_abs(i) = ABS(SEQV_raw(i))
*ENDDO

!"UPDATE ELEMENT VON MISES STRESS"
*VPUT,SEQV_abs,ELEM, ,ETAB,e_SEQV

/SOL

BUCOPT,LANB,Modes,0,0,CENTER

Multi = 1e20
*DO,i,1,Modes,1

alpha = 1

*DIM,S_Ratio,ARRAY,n_Elem,1,1, , , 

!"ARRAY TO STORE ITERATION RESULTS"

*DO,i,1,n_Elem,1

		ratio = e_VM/YS

		*ENDIF
*ENDDO

!"CLEAR MESH, BC & LOADS"

/PREP7
LCLEAR,ALL
LSCLEAR,ALL

!"CREATE ELEMENT CROSS-SECTION AREAS"
*DO,i,1,n_Elem,1
		d_Area = (e_Area(i)*S_Ratio(i)-e_Area(i))*alpha

		SECTYPE,i,LINK, ,Truss
		SECDATA,e_Area(i)
		SECCONTROL,0,0
*ENDDO

!"UPDATE ELEMENT CROSS-SECTION AREAS"
*DO,i,1,n_Elem,1

FITEM,2,1

				max_Disp_Y = node_Disp_Y(i)
		*ENDIF
*ENDDO

*VGET,SEQV_raw,ELEM, ,ETAB,e_SEQV
*DO,i,1,n_Elem,1
		SEQV_abs(i) = ABS(SEQV_raw(i))
